SURREY COUNTY A.A.A. 2 Miles (Wartime Championship). 7/7/43. 1 C.

Len Fletcher's welcome return to the road after a long lapse, resulted in him winning a County medal, our other three scoring members filling the first three individual placings. In the Middlesex event (Cadogan A.C.), Jack Rutland had rather a bad time and finished second to the Police Champion, C.

Our own open did not attract quite as large an entry as had been anticipated, but of the 176 entries 158 started on a signal from the Club President. Harry Churcher contented himself with accompanying C. Morris of the Surrey A.C. for the first lap, after which he began to make a lead.
